Lack of Practical Experience: Graduating with a high GPA but no internship or project experience makes landing an engineering job difficult. Avoid this by joining FIU project clubs like SAE Formula SAE or taking on undergraduate design research early.

Resume part-time studies at MDC using Federal Tuition Assistance (FTA) and remaining financial aid to cover classes.
Complete final AS in Cybersecurity courses, leveraging your military IT experience for prior learning credits where applicable.
Graduate with your AS in Cybersecurity, secure full-time contractor or civilian defense roles utilizing your active security clearance.
